requirements.details: IELTS (Academic) 6.5 (with no less than 6.0 in each element) TOEFL (iBT) For tests taken up to January 2026 90 (minimum 19 in Writing and Listening, 20 in Reading and 22 in Speaking) TOEFL (iBT) For tests taken from February 2026 4.5 (with no less than 4.5 in each element) PTE (Academic) 71 (with no less than 65 in each element) GCE A Level English Language or English Literature Grade C GCE AS Level English Language or English Literature Grade C SPM CEFR level B2 (including B2 in each element) GCSE O-Level Grade C / 4 IGCSE (first language) Grade C / 4 IGCSE (second language) Grade B / 6 MUET Band 4.5 UEC Grade A2 IB English A1 or A2 (Standard or Higher Level) 4 points IB English B (Higher Level) 4 points IB English B (Standard Level) 5 points OSSD English (ENG3U/ENG4U) (No fast-track route) 75% CBSE/CISCE Class XII 75% overall (confirmation that English was the medium of instruction is required) IELTS (Academic), TOEFL iBT, and PTE (Academic) test results must be less than two years old. OSSD English (ENG3U/ENG4U) with the required grades will only be accepted if applicants have completed all 30 credits from standard OSSD courses, not through credit exemptions. English language tests must be taken at a test centre situated in the applicant’s country of residence. International applicants who meet the University’s requirements may also need to submit extra documents or an approved English test for MOHE, if required.

requirements.label: Australian Year 12 entry route
requirements.details: Australian Year 12 qualification. ATAR 82. Applicants are required to meet specific grade standards in Mathematics and either Chemistry or Physics, aligned with A Level subject requirements. To fulfil these A Level standards, specific grade equivalents in the Senior Secondary Certificate of Education (SSCE) are required. For WACE, applicants must have studied both Mathematics Methods and Mathematics Specialist. For SACE, both Mathematical Methods and Specialist Mathematics are required. For other states and territories, the mathematics subjects will be reviewed on a case-by-case basis.

requirements.label: Ontario OSSD entry route
requirements.details: Ontario OSSD qualification. 77% average based on 6 subjects, including Advanced Functions, Calculus and Vectors, and either Chemistry or Physics. Applicants must meet specific grade requirements for subjects required at A Level: 75% for C and 81% for B. Canadian Secondary School Diplomas from other provinces are acceptable and will be assessed based on the University’s requirements.

source.title: Nottingham Malaysia 2027 · MEng (Hons) in Chemical Engineering · Ontario OSSD entry route

requirements.label: Gaokao and Chinese school diploma entry route
requirements.details: Gaokao and Chinese school diploma qualification. A 70% average in the Gaokao, including at least two required subjects (Mathematics and either Chemistry or Physics) with scores of 75% and 73%, respectively. In addition, a minimum of 78% overall in the Senior High School Diploma is required, including at least two required subjects (Mathematics and either Chemistry or Physics) with scores of 80% and 70%, respectively. Gaokao scores are converted from 750 to a percentage scale.

IELTS One Skill Retake is accepted. IELTS Academic Online, TOEFL iBT Home Edition, and PTE Academic Online are not accepted. MUET results are valid for five years from the release date. OSSD English (ENG3U/ENG4U) with the required grades will only be accepted if applicants have completed all 30 credits from standard OSSD courses, not through credit exemptions. Fast-track routes are not accepted. CBSE/CISCE Class XII English with the required grades will only be accepted if applicants provide a confirmation letter stating that English was the medium of instruction in Class XII. English language tests must be taken at a test centre situated in the applicant’s country of residence. International applicants who meet the University’s requirements may also need to submit extra documents or an approved English test for MOHE, if required.

source.title: Nottingham Malaysia 2027 · BSc (Hons) in Biotechnology · English language scores and evidence

In addition, a minimum overall score of 75% in the Senior High School Diploma is required, including two science subjects, preferably from Biology, Chemistry, Geography, Mathematics, or Physics, with at least one subject at 80% and the other at 70%. Gaokao scores are converted from 750 to a percentage scale.
